notes: Libretto by Emanuel Schikaneder (1791). Words as printed in the Edition Peters vocal score, which the app follows where it differs from the libretto: "Ich sollte fort?" with a question mark, "könnt'", "Hätt'", "geh'" and "wiederseh'" (one word) as printed, and the many repeats of the music. Each Lady has her own line. The Allegro from bar 55 is repeated: the first time the Ladies end in bar 68 and sing "Du" as the upbeat back to bar 55 ("Jüngling…"); the second time they skip bar 68 and end the word "wiederseh'" on "seh'" in bar 69. Those two pieces are phrases of their own here. IPA follows sung German stage diction: final -er, -ern as [ɐ]; the prefixes er-, ver-, zer- with [ɛr]; r elsewhere rolled or flipped; ch as [ç] after front vowels and [x] after back vowels; glottal stops [ʔ] before initial vowels; final b d g devoiced.
